synthetic_generation.recipe: Uniform random positions in 50x50 square, k=5 KNN graph; Laplacian pseudoinverse square root with first eigenvalue set to zero; low-frequency initial signal, Gaussian increments propagated by L^-1/2; R=3000; Gaussian observation noise sigma=0.1 or0.3;20% point masking. Scalability uses same generation procedure.
